title: ThreadAtlas Step 0: Documents, Units, Pieces
subtitle: 24,071 documents split into dated units, with a per-piece speaker table
description:
Every document in the IT 494 memory-backend corpus, split into units, with a piece table that says what each stretch of a file is, who is speaking, and when it is from. 24,071 documents, 251,446 units, 252,830 pieces, every unit dated, produced in one pass by a public notebook for $8.24.

**Not a chunker.** Nothing is cut on length. A language model reads a numbered list of a book's or paper's own lines and says where the regions, the pieces and the separate works begin; units group those natural parts up to a size cap, cutting only at boundaries the model named and copied back so the copy could be checked. A chat needs no model: each turn is a unit of its own, dated by its own timestamp.

**Every unit is dated.** A book or paper unit carries the date its work was written, from the page or from a web search on its title and author, BC and approximate dates included; a volume of several works is dated work by work, and a unit never spans two dates. A document is dated by its earliest unit. The source of every date is in the document's flags.

**LongMemEval in its 500 histories.** Each question's history is its own folder of chat documents, every session dated as that history dates it, so a knowledge graph can load one user's timeline. Nothing from the test itself is included.

Verified on all 24,071 documents: pieces and units tile every document; unit ids are unique and recompute from the text; no unit mixes kinds or spans two dates; every chat turn's date equals its history's.

**Files.** `documents.jsonl` (24,071 rows), `units.jsonl` (251,446), `pieces.jsonl` (252,830), `attribution.jsonl` (100 CC-BY papers), `receipt.json`. `README.md`, `SCHEMA.md`, `METHOD.md`, `PROVENANCE.md` and `LIMITS.md` are in the dataset.

**The papers are CC-BY, and attribution is a condition of that license.** Render the authors, the title and the license from `attribution.jsonl` wherever a paper's text is shown or quoted.

**Licensing is layered.** Packaging, schema and every derived field are MIT. The literature is public domain in the United States. GraphRAG-Bench and LongMemEval are MIT. The papers are CC-BY. See PROVENANCE.md.

**Known limits are documented.** Three Sophocles plays carry a translation year from their page, three Scientific American articles carry wrong looked-up dates, and 15 units have no date because no source gave one. LIMITS.md gives the full list.

Made by https://www.kaggle.com/code/jhffmn/threadatlas-extractor (threadatlas-extractor 1.8, gpt-5.6-luna on the Flex tier). Raw inputs: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/jhffmn/it494-narrative-corpora-raw

IT 494 directed project, Illinois State University, fall 2026.
userSpecifiedSources:
SOURCES. Project Gutenberg (29 Oz volumes, 9 Sherlock Holmes volumes, 26 volumes of Greek and Roman literature); Archive.org institutional scans (5 OCR'd volumes); GraphRAG-Bench novel contexts, MIT, https://github.com/GraphRAG-Bench/GraphRAG-Benchmark ; LongMemEval-S, MIT, https://github.com/xiaowu0162/LongMemEval ; and 100 full-text papers on knowledge graphs and retrieval-augmented generation gathered from OpenAlex, every one Creative Commons Attribution.

COLLECTION. Every raw file was fetched by a title-verifying script that records source URL, bytes and sha256, and is published byte-identical at https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/jhffmn/it494-narrative-corpora-raw . LongMemEval's benchmark file is unpacked inside the extractor into one folder per question's history, every turn dated by that history; no question, answer or evidence data is written.

PROCESSING. One pass of https://www.kaggle.com/code/jhffmn/threadatlas-extractor (threadatlas-extractor 1.8, gpt-5.6-luna on the Flex tier) on 2026-09-13. Each book or paper is shown to the model as numbered lines; a boundary is kept only when the model's copy of a line verifies against it. Each work is dated by when it was written: from its page when a pointer proves it, else from a web search whose source URL is recorded. Units group pieces up to 4,000 words and never span two kinds or two dates. Total cost $8.24.

LICENSING. Packaging, schema and every derived field are MIT. The literature is public domain in the United States. GraphRAG-Bench and LongMemEval are MIT. The 100 papers are CC-BY, redistributed with the attribution attribution.jsonl carries.

KNOWN LIMITS. Three Sophocles plays carry a translation year from their page; three Scientific American articles carry wrong looked-up dates; 15 units of 12 works have no date because no source gave one; 50 of 135 pointer mismatches could not be recovered. LIMITS.md gives the counts and the diagnosis. Not ground truth.

PART OF the IT 494 directed project, Illinois State University, fall 2026.
